tools.name: list_lyric_styles_and_tools
tools.description: List all animated lyric text styles (free 720p vs 1080p Pro), themes, background counts (including MP3/Suno auto cover art and 21 video loops), 24-band audio visualizer modes, output formats (16:9 / 9:16), and the 4 free browser audio/subtitle tools on LyricsMove.

tools.name: list_ai_mv_styles
tools.description: List all 11 selectable AI music video visual styles on LyricsMove (Cinema V2: 8–32 beat-snapped story scenes, up to 10 animated clips, consistent recurring characters from lyrics or a user photo) with mood guidance, YouTube showcase links, and studio URL.

tools.name: recommend_video_setup
tools.description: Given a song genre, mood or workflow goal (lyric video, AI music video, Suno URL, or audio/subtitle conversion), recommend the best LyricsMove visual style(s) and return the direct browser URL.

tools.name: get_pricing_and_limits
tools.description: Get exact pricing (free 720p lyric videos with no signup, $3.90 per 1080p song, $9.90 per 8–32 scene AI music video, starter pack, Pro and Ultra plans), audio/video upload limits, and retention policy.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_ai_mv_styles · Public sink: get_pricing_and_limits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_ai_mv_styles · Public sink: get_pricing_and_limits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
